title: •Leia’s Sporting Blaster
caption: •Leia’s Sporting Blaster (V)
lore: Defender sporting blaster, made by Drearian Defense Conglomerate. Intended for personal defense or small-game hunting. Short range. Low power. Carries energy for 50 shots.
game_text: Deploy on Leia or your non-droid Undercover spy. May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny > defense value. During opponent’s move phase, if on your Undercover spy, may ‘break cover’ to fire.
